_comment: Leaf Café & Bistro — Acomb Road, York. Landing page ported from the supplied design handoff (leaf-cafe-bistro-build-kit). The shop is PRE-LAUNCH: see the prelaunch flag at the bottom, and the UNCONFIRMED list below.
_comment_unconfirmed: STILL NEEDED FROM THE OWNER before this can go live: (1) postcode for 124A Acomb Road — needed for the address and seo.geo; (2) phone and orders email — both PRINT on the page, so the build warns about them by name; (3) the real opening hours (the ones below are a placeholder shaped around 'breakfast, lunch, bistro evenings' and are almost certainly wrong); (4) legal name + company number; (5) the Stripe Connect acct_ id; (6) the real menu — see _comment_menu.
_comment_ordering: DECIDED: Leaf is ONLINE ORDERS ONLY — no table booking — and does BOTH delivery and collection. The supplied design was a booking shape ('Book a table', 'View menu' links that went nowhere); the landing page has been reworked so every call to action lands on /order.
_comment_menu: menu.json / menu-visual.json are still STUBS. The design handoff shipped no dish list — its menu section is typographic by design (Breakfast / Lunch / Bistro, no items, no prices). They must be replaced with Leaf's real menu before the shop can take an order, and the two files must agree item-for-item or the build fails.

business._comment_shortName: Conversational short form used in page headers, aria labels and the staff PWA name.

address._comment_postcode: NOT KNOWN. Acomb Road is in the YO24 area but the exact unit postcode must come from the owner — do not guess it, it drives seo.geo and any future delivery geocoding.

business._comment_contact: Both of these PRINT on the customer-facing pages. The landing page deliberately does not render a phone number anywhere (the design doesn't have one), so a placeholder here is not visible on the landing page itself — but it is on the shared order/terms pages.

_comment_theme: Straight from the design handoff's stated palette: forest green #153B31, dark green #102D25, muted gold #C39B52, pale gold #D5B573, warm ivory #F0EADF, oatmeal #EBE2D2. primaryDeep is the only value not in that list — darkened from #102D25 for the footer.

fulfillment._comment_delivery: ON — the owner has confirmed Leaf does delivery as well as collection. ⚠️ THE AREAS AND FEES BELOW ARE NOT CONFIRMED. They are a starting point only, shaped on Leaf sitting on Acomb Road in the same part of York as Mega Chippy (Gale Lane): the YO24/YO26/YO23 outcodes nearest the shop, one flat fee, a 3-mile cap. EVERY ONE OF THESE NUMBERS MUST COME FROM THE OWNER BEFORE LAUNCH — a wrong fee is charged on every single delivery order, and a wrong outcode either turns away a street the shop serves or commits it to one it does not. If Leaf prices by distance rather than postcode, switch mode to 'radius' and use bands instead (see data/shops/_template/config.json).

delivery._comment_maxMiles: Road-distance cap layered on top of the outcode list, so an outcode that sprawls past the round cannot be ordered from. roadFactor scales straight-line distance to approximate a driven route.

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order platform fee in pence. Charged to the customer and kept by the platform.
_comment_hours: PLACEHOLDER — NOT CONFIRMED BY THE OWNER. Shaped around the design's 'breakfast, lunch, bistro evenings' story: daytime trade all week, plus Friday and Saturday evenings. Every one of these windows needs checking before launch. 24-hour format; a close after midnight is written as 25:00 = 01:00 next day.

ordering._comment_businessDayStartHour: 4 = the trading day runs 4am-to-4am. Safe for a daytime shop; nothing trades in the 0–4am window to reclassify.

_comment_pos: Left at the takeaway default deliberately. Leaf is a sit-in café and bistro, so IF it takes a till, pos.serviceStyle should become "hospitality" and pos.tables should list the room's real tables (optionally grouped by area). That is not set here because inventing table numbers would print fictional tables on kitchen tickets and receipts — worse than leaving it. serviceStyle is inert until a till is provisioned, so this costs nothing today.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact the café before ordering.

_comment_prelaunch: KEEPS THE SHOP OUT OF GOOGLE. Every page sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex and robots.txt is Disallow-all. REMOVE THIS LINE ON LAUNCH DAY or the site stays invisible.

seo._comment_description: The line Google shows under the result, written for a person. Leads with the brand name plus Acomb because that adjacency is what a local search matches on.
seo.description: Leaf Café & Bistro — an independent café and bistro on Acomb Road, York. Breakfasts, relaxed lunches and bistro evenings. Order online for delivery or collection in Acomb and York.
seo._comment_ogImage: The picture shown when the link is shared. Supplied in the design handoff as a 1200x630 card built from the real interior photo and the gold wordmark.
seo._comment_geo: MISSING and must not be guessed. Look the postcode up on api.postcodes.io once the owner confirms it, and paste the real latitude/longitude here.
seo._comment_sameAs: MISSING. Add Leaf's Facebook / Instagram / Google Business profile URLs once known.
